description: UK Pension Credit for 2026-27 (DWP): weekly Guarantee Credit (tops income up to £238.00 single / £363.25 couple, plus severe disability £86.05, carer £48.15 and allowed housing costs) and Savings Credit (only if State Pension age was reached before 6 April 2016: 60% of qualifying income above £208.07 / £329.75, max £17.96 / £20.10, less 40% of income above the appropriate amount). Savings: first £10,000 ignored, then £1 a week per £500 or part; no upper limit. Attendance Allowance, PIP, DLA, Child Benefit and Housing Benefit are not income. Reproduces DWP's four worked examples. Use this when someone asks whether they (or a parent) could get Pension Credit or how much.
